question: Estimate monthly air conditioner (AC) sales in Delhi NCR during peak summer.
idealClarificationQuestions: Residential split AC + window AC (excludes commercial)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total annual AC sales × peak season concentration × NCR share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian AC market FY26: ~120 lakh units/year (12M).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Peak summer (Apr-Jun) concentration: ~50% of annual sales = ~60 lakh units in 3 months.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Monthly peak: ~2.4 lakh AC units in NCR (single peak month — May).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~50% of annual sales = ~60 lakh units in 3 months.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~2.4 lakh AC units in NCR (single peak month — May).

calculationFlow: Indian AC market FY26: ~120 lakh units/year (12M).
Peak summer (Apr-Jun) concentration: ~50% of annual sales = ~60 lakh units in 3 months.
Delhi NCR share of national AC market (hottest large metro): ~12% = 60L × 12% = ~7.2 lakh units in 3 months.
Monthly peak: ~2.4 lakh AC units in NCR (single peak month — May).
